invasion.lead: Invasions in progress and the weapon parts you have collected from them. The invasion list is refreshed when you press Update from official data.
invasion.cached: (within 60 seconds, so the previous result was used)
invasion.nodata: No official data yet. Press Update from official data.
invasion.stale: The saved official data has no invasions (it was fetched before this page existed). Press Update from official data.
invasion.noregions: Node names are not available yet, so internal names are shown. Run Data Update to get them.
invasion.broken: The parts list (bundled data) could not be read.
invasion.unknown: Weapon parts not in the list are being offered
invasion.unknown.help: These parts are missing from the bundled list (data/invasion/parts.json). Please report them.
invasion.note: Rewards are earned by completing three missions for that side. Finished invasions are hidden. Collected checks are saved on this PC and survive tool updates.
